test_cli_download: test the transformers CLI download command by downloading a model to a temporary cache directory
test_cli_download_trust_remote: test the transformers CLI download command with the trust-remote-code flag for dynamic models
run_download_model: run the transformers CLI to download a model repository to a specified cache directory
run_download_trust_remote: run the transformers CLI to download a model with trust-remote-code enabled for dynamic code
verify_download_structure: verify that downloaded model files contain the expected blobs, refs, and snapshots directories
